verification.label: owned lifecycle, single-flight, and cleanup evidence
verification.measures: Asserts immediate stdin EOF; serial start/end timing; duplicate request and command execution counts; TERM then KILL event order; worker deadline/crash recovery; bounded waiter and stale-owner recovery; and absence of child, grandchild, worker, lock waiter, or poller after terminal cleanup.

verification.label: immutable snapshot, mutation, index, and final binding evidence
verification.measures: Asserts copied byte/type/mode/symlink/index identity; concurrent snapshot-race rejection before launch; immutable attempt IDs; source/index before and after digests and changed paths; fail-closed readiness; and exactly one final-suite result bound to the reviewed candidate.

verification.label: current-source worker and controller-independence evidence
verification.measures: Asserts a version-A parent launches captured version B from the immutable snapshot and matches its source hash/protocol version; mutation of the live worker path after capture is never executed and is reported fail-closed; one transaction handles 19 deduplicated commands with zero verification controller turns or evaluation drain and one final-suite execution.

verification.label: same-attempt delayed and expired evidence
verification.measures: Asserts delayed and expired cases retain the original attempt ID and one command execution, record bounded retry events, terminate polling, and end respectively as evidence-present or explicitly unresolved/absent.

verification.label: snapshot escape rejection
verification.measures: Asserts a `cd`/absolute-path/traversal/shell-chain argv aimed at the live worktree is rejected before launch, and a permitted command's actual OS-level cwd resolves inside the validated snapshot checkout, never the live worktree.

verification.label: clean-checkout compatibility and verification attribution
verification.measures: Asserts identical normalized fixture inputs and verdict without ignored/generated ledger state; preserved interactive, noninteractive, headless, resume, controller, readiness, measurement, and reporting outcomes; separate subprocess cost; and per-focused-check invalidation, reuse, reviewer-finding, and marginal-cost fields.

verification.label: this plan's own verification inventory validates against the schema-2 validator
verification.measures: Loads this plan.json's result.verification array itself (not a synthetic fixture) and asserts the real inventory validator accepts it: every entry has label/command/execution_mode/kind, every command is a safe argv array with no cd/absolute-path/traversal/shell-metacharacter token, exactly one kind=final_suite entry exists, and it is last.

verification.label: CLI preflight
verification.measures: Confirms the existing CLI installation/configuration preflight remains green without mutating the candidate.

verification.label: full unit suite including owned verification transaction regressions
verification.measures: Runs the complete repository regression envelope last and exactly once on the immutable reviewed snapshot, including the self-validation test above.
